source.name: EmpatheticDialogues plus ConvLab-normalized DailyDialog plus frozen protected tasks
source.use: private research; this freezer does not assert redistribution rights

policy.selection: lowest fixed-seed SHA-256 rank within source and mapped axis
policy.protected_policy: always force no actuation independent of G1 route

sample_size_extension.reason: original frozen 50-row set yielded 16 active rows below the frozen minimum of 20
sample_size_extension.outcome_blinding: no control, candidate, judge, embedding, evaluation, or holdout output existed
sample_size_extension.rule: double every original source-label count where available; use all four eligible DailyDialog fear rows
